full_judgment: 2. Relevant facts for the disposal of the Rule are that the present respondents No. 4-9 as plaintiffs filed Vested Property Suit No. 428 of 2012 before the Vested Property Prottarpan Additional Tribunal No. 2, Chandpur (shortly, the Tribunal) stating, inter alia, that Gopinath Tulal was the owner of half of 5.37 decimals of land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 640, CS Plot No. 2576, SA. Khatian No. 879 SA Plot No. 5565/5533 of 91 Chandpur Municipality mouza. The said property was sold in auction in execution of the decree of Money Suit No. 2/67 of the Court of 3rd Sub-Judge, Cumilla filed by one Ali Akber Tofader. Abul Khayer Miah purchased the property in the auction. On 8-11-71 Abul Khayer Miah got the sale certificate and he also got possession through Court. Shahid Ullah Miah, the predecessor of the plaintiffs purchased the suit land from said Abul Khayer Miah vide a kabala deed bearing No. 4234 dated 4-6-73. Through the Mutation Case No. 174/84-85, Shahid Ullah Miah mutated the land in his name in Mutation Khatian No. 2899. At the death of Shahid Ullah Mia, the plaintiffs became the owners and possessors of the suit land by way of inheritance. The suit land was wrongly published in the Gazette of vested property. Hence the plaintiffs filed the suit for releasing the property from the list of vested properties.
